brief: The clock became a button at #67 and joined OFFERS last, after `follow` — so a visitor who never taps a person hears 'press the hour' ~30 real s in, after the daylight they would have skipped is gone. Re-order OFFERS so the clock's offer is heard SECOND (after the first touch invitation), and make sure `found: () => clockPressed` still retires it. Check what the narrow (390 px) sill does with the order — it keeps the clock via `at-clock`. One hour; no new mechanism.
successLooksLike: A fresh page with no taps hears the evening offer before ~12 real s (print the real-time each offer surfaces, HEAD vs HERE); the follow and season offers still surface and still retire on their `found`; touch-hint.mjs and season-invite.mjs pass; the 390 px sill shows the clock on the same row as the controls.
avoid: Do not add a hint line for the clock. Do not change TICK_DWELL or the queue depth. Do not touch beginEvening().
